rows.question: Can I appeal my final exam grade if I think it was unfair?
rows.gold: Yes, students have the right to appeal their final exam grade.
rows.answer: Yes, you can appeal your final exam grade if you believe it was unfairly assessed. Only final exam grades may be appealed [1][2]. The appeal process involves first contacting the professor responsible for the course within the appeal period to discuss the grading scheme [3][4]. If unresolved, you can submit a formal appeal form to the Office of Registrar within two weeks of receiving the grade [3][4]. The Examination and Appeals Committee will then review the grade independently and notify you of their decision within thirty calendar days [3][4]. The committee's decision is final, and the revised grade can be equal to, higher than, or lower than the original grade [2][3][4].
